title: Forecast-informed reserve-SOC supervision for drilling-rig power systems: V24/V28 reproducibility package
description: Compact code, configuration, manuscript, and evidence-audit package for the V24 same-simulator controller study and bounded V28 public real-data checks. Raw third-party datasets and bulk experiment outputs are excluded; source identities and compact audit evidence are retained. The package does not establish target-rig closed-loop efficacy, HIL validation, deployment safety, or cross-rig generalization. Code is licensed under MIT; author-generated documentation and evidence artifacts are licensed under CC BY 4.0; manuscript and third-party materials are excluded or separately licensed as stated in LICENSE.
